facts.fact: The Central Bank of The Gambia says fintech and mobile money services have 5.4 million registered users and 2.9 million active users, with cash-in up 16.4 percent to D23.9 billion and cash-out up 19.6 percent to D25.8 billion between September and December 2025.

GMB.note: Revenue is discussed as fiscal totals only; no electronic payment stated.
